snippet.title: Clutter 12: It's About Time Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Puzzles by Joe is back with the most challenging entry in the series with Clutter 12: It's About Time

The classic gameplay you crave is back with tons of new variations to twist your brain as you explore the story of time itself! Learn to contend with a variety of classic and new puzzles, including Sliders, Square Jigsaws, Box Quotes, Spirals, Portals, Singletons, and more! With over 2100 puzzles to solve, Clutter has never been this challenging... or this fun!

Download the Free Trial for PC!
https://www.bigfishgames.com/pc-games/

Available for Game Club members on February 13th, 2022.
